messages:
mina: ran quick compare of a new q4_0 quantized export for orion-lite (bring-up) vs fp16 on zh-Hans -> en devset. BLEU dropped ~ -2.8. Repro shows weird tokenization/detokenization around mixed numbers/currency: grouping punctuation becomes inconsistent (middle-dot, ideographic comma, or control-like glyph).
owen: can you paste a tiny repro and token traces? sounds like detok mapping corruption in quant export.
mina: minimal repro below:

input: 预计2026年总收入为 1,234,567 元。
baseline (fp16): Total revenue expected in 2026 is 1,234,567 yuan.
orion-q4: Total revenue expected in 2026 is 12346700 yuan.

mina: token traces:
baseline.tokens: ["1", ",234", ",567", " ", "元"]
orion-q4.tokens: ["1", "\u0000", "\u001E234", "\u0667", "00", " ", "元"]

owen: that looks like remap buffer or detok table packing got mangled: NUL and odd codepoints inside digit runs. Could be an export packing endianness bug or an uninitialized mapping table for quant kernels.
ci-bot: eval job #22011 completed: BLEU delta -2.8 (p < 0.01). Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/orion-q4/22011
sre-raf: any customer impact? parsers failing in canary?
mina: yes, a couple of ingestion jobs validate numbers strictly and dropped rows in canary. We rolled back that route to fp16 earlier.
owen: short-term mitigation: add a post-detok sanitizer in the serving shim that normalizes any non-ASCII grouping characters inside digit runs to ASCII comma and strips control bytes. I can PR a small shim to canary.
mina: adding failing examples to tests/locale/zh_grouping_normalize.json and filing ticket RD-9999 "Quantized detok packing corruption causing non-ASCII and control bytes in numeric grouping for CJK locales" tagging eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra.
owen: will start a bisect on export/runtime changes that touched detok packing. bisect job queued: https://ci.internal/ci/jobs/bisect-detok-22012 (est ~2h).
sre-raf: routing fallback applied for zh->en canary -> fp16. Monitor numeric-parse-fail metric.
mina: thanks. sanitizer + route fallback should mitigate while we find root cause. Please post bisect range when ready. :thumbsup:
